title: Let it fall
description: Weighted letter tiles drop into a shallow tray and return to their original line.
useCase: Add a rare, playful typographic moment to a campaign or a creative empty state.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: A choreographed drop with authored end poses. This does not simulate arbitrary letter collisions or physics.
look: Mustard-yellow field with four red block tiles bearing cream bold serif capitals, resting tilted on a brown shelf, and a small text button below.
motion: Pressing the button drops the tiles onto the shelf 35 ms apart with a 0.65 s bounce curve and authored tilts; pressing again lifts them back with 0.35 s ease-out.
adapt: Each tile's inline `transform` drops it to the tray floor and rotates it by `[-13, 8, -6, 15]`, staggered by `transitionDelay`; the bounce is the 0.65 s transition on `.letters span`, the return `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`. Replace `"DROP"` and its angles together.
